title: Prefill: indexer logits + exact top-k
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: baseline MEASURED in-step (INFRA NVFP4 prefill baseline 17:48: idx_score 9.86 + DSA.topk 4.77 + idx quant/insert 0.70 over 6 DSA layers); current = stock until the new path is wired in-step. New-path microbench (1 GPU, P3-16 per-GPU shape 3 x 5461 rows at 78360 keys, per DSA layer): score 1.48 ms (bitwise = DeepGEMM) + best select 0.65 ms (row-group select, commit 16cf954219) = 2.13 ms vs stock 2.22 ms
gap_analysis: Target 9.28 ms over 6 DSA layers = 1.43 ms/layer for score + select in-step (+0.12 quant/insert). Stock in-step 2.55 ms/layer. SOL design: (1) persistent tcgen05 score (keys on M=128, 8 tokens x 32 heads on N=256, 2x-K MXF4, 2 TMEM accumulator stages, stock packed-BF16 epilogue, BF16 logits written once, per-row 11-bit histogram -> row bound); (2) bandwidth-bound exact select: one streaming read of the logits marks keys above the bound bin in a position bitmap and keeps the bound bin's keys, exact low digit + lowest-position ties, bitmap written out in position order. Hardware floors per layer: score epilogue ~0.68 ms (MEASURED probe: BF16x2 FMA pipe binds; 32 instr per (token,key)), TMEM reads 0.39 ms, MMA+key stream 0.54 ms (measured), select read of 2.5 GB ~0.18 ms. MEASURED state: score 1.48 ms = ~93 executed instr per warp-tile (64 math) at ~61% issue efficiency; the TMEM read burst (all 16 warps load the stage at once, ~160 clk/tile) is not overlapped with math; every in-warp pipelining variant (half-tile x16, token-granularity x32, with setmaxnreg 104/112) spilled or ran slower (1.56-2.10 ms). Select: the row-group kernel is latency-bound (0.65 ms); the two-kernel mark+finish (exact) runs 1.30 + 0.37 ms because both keep too few bytes in flight: global loads inside loops are serialized (asm volatile + memory clobbers stop the compiler from batching them) and mark keeps only ~32 KB in flight per SM (HBM needs ~128 KB). MODEL NOTE: the model prices idx_score as an FP32-SIMT epilogue (1.206 ms/layer); stock math is packed BF16 (binding pipe ~0.68 ms/layer), so the model over-prices the score epilogue ~1.8x; its total (1.41 ms/layer) remains a valid target.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: score epilogue ~61% issue efficiency: TMEM read burst per tile (128 KB, ~160 clk) not overlapped with the 64-instruction reduction; register cap 96 (18 warps) blocks double-buffering

MEASURED: select kernels keep too few bytes in flight: loop-carried global loads serialized (volatile asm), mark ~32 KB/SM in flight vs ~128 KB needed; finish walks cand / bitmap words one dependent load at a time
MEASURED: BF16 threshold ties are common (~tens of keys equal the k-th value) -> tie ordering must be cheap (now ranked in shared memory)
MODEL ERROR: idx_score epilogue priced as FP32 SIMT; stock math is packed BF16 (binding pipe measured)
rubin_features: 2x-K block-scaled MMA (mxf4 K128) via sm_107a descriptors
576-column exclusive TMEM (2 accumulator stages + scale factors)
oversized shared memory for 4 concurrent per-row select groups
plan: Select (biggest remaining lever): PrefillMark is still ~4x above its HBM floor (0.83 vs ~0.2 ms): per 2048-vector unit it pays 4 CTA barriers + one global atomic round trip + one shared-memory slot claim per warp-vector. Next: fixed per-(row, chunk) candidate regions (count per chunk, no global atomic; finish reads all chunks' lists), one slot claim per warp per unit, persistent units with the next unit's loads issued before the current is processed (2 CTAs/SM x 256 threads at <=128 regs). PrefillFinish 0.19 ms: process 2 rows per warp-pass or more warps per CTA. Target mark ~0.2 + finish ~0.05 ms/layer.

Score: overlap the TMEM read burst with math without more registers: stagger warpgroups (odd WGs process the tile pair in the opposite stage order) or split each stage into two N=128 MMAs with separate full barriers so half the WGs start early; target <= 1.1 ms/layer

Wire in-step: hook in sparse_attn_indexer prefill branch (vllm/model_executor/layers/sparse_attn_indexer.py, minimal) -> specialized_prefill.indexer entry for non-DCP / non-PCP / MXFP4 / sm_107 pure-prefill steps: per step (cache on chunk.logits_inputs) one host read of cu_seqlen_ks/ke -> plan(); per layer: stock cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache per request into a 128-aligned key buffer, mqa_logits_mx_inputs, score, select into topk_indices_buffer rows; scratch from the workspace manager (logits ~2.4 GB at F16K: chunk rows if the budget requires)

Unit test tests/models/kimi_k3/test_specialized_prefill_indexer_gpu.py from bench_pidx_fused.check (bitwise logits vs DeepGEMM, exact top-k incl. ties / overflow / >131072-key rows); step A/B: step_p.sh -n P-IDX -q nvfp4 <overlay on wzhao/k31ws-int> 1

Rule of thumb learned: in these CuTe DSL SIMT kernels, every global/shared load inside a loop is serialized by the volatile asm helpers -> always issue a batch of independent loads before consuming them.
